issues.expected: A known Crystal login failure should tell the player what action is needed.
issues.actual: The native dialog exposed only the raw text `login failed (result 3)`.

evidence.stateBefore: Login form with an account absent from the active account store.
evidence.stateAfter: Login form showing raw result code 3.

issues.verification: Unit coverage added for Crystal result codes 0–5, unknown codes, missing codes and authoritative ban reasons.

issues.expected: Holding left click to a ground tile should perform Crystal's throttled pickup check once the authoritative player reaches that tile.
issues.actual: The pointer movement stopped at the destination without the held-input pickup check; only the initial click path could emit `PickUpTile`.

evidence.stateBefore: Held left pointer movement toward an empty target tile.
evidence.stateAfter: Authoritative arrival with no tile pickup intent.

issues.verification: Regression test confirms one normal Gateway intent on arrival and a 200 ms repeat throttle.

issues.expected: Ctrl+V should paste filtered clipboard text into the focused account or password field without exposing password contents.
issues.actual: Ctrl+V had no effect in either native login field, forcing credentials to be entered one key at a time.

evidence.stateBefore: Native login form with focus in an editable account or password field.
evidence.stateAfter: Clipboard text was not inserted after Ctrl+V.

issues.verification: Seven focused tests and the full 503-test Windows host suite passed. The final Windows host rebuilt, and Computer Use verified real Ctrl+V insertion in both the account field and the masked password field. Paste is scoped to shell fields, modifier state resets on focus loss, and the temporary password clipboard value was cleared after the check.

issues.expected: Holding left or right pointer movement should chain Crystal-paced walk/run presentation while the shared Zone remains authoritative.
issues.actual: The native controller allowed only one pending move, so every visual step waited for its UserLocation ACK before the next command and sustained movement visibly paused between steps.

evidence.stateBefore: One pending movement intent with planning blocked until ACK.
evidence.stateAfter: A bounded two-intent FIFO presentation window with authoritative correction and timeout rollback.

issues.verification: Four new regressions cover boundary prefetch, a strict two-intent cap, ordered late-ACK retirement, correction rollback, and snapshot prefix confirmation. The complete Windows host suite passes 507/507; rebuilt-client player verification remains open.

issues.expected: HUD HP/MP, level and minimap labels should remain centered inside their Crystal source rectangles.
issues.actual: Single-line labels drifted to the left because Bevy ignored text justification for an unbounded NoWrap layout.

evidence.stateBefore: TextLayout justification applied to a full-width child whose NoWrap text layout remained unbounded.
evidence.stateAfter: Fixed Crystal rectangle owns flex alignment and the text child is auto-sized.

issues.verification: The focused HUD suite passes 31/31 and the full native-UI suite passes 464/464. Authenticated in-game visual capture remains open.

issues.expected: Connection loss should render inside Crystal's original message box with readable bounded text and one source-sized OK button.
issues.actual: The generic confirm panel mixed title, instruction, raw localized socket error and duplicate Retry text in overlapping rectangles.

evidence.gatewayEvents: Gateway unavailable; real connection failure path used.
evidence.stateBefore: Prguse/1084 confirm/input panel and unrelated Title/320..322 button geometry.
evidence.stateAfter: Prguse/360 at 456x190 with Title/200..202 OK at 76x25 and bounded summary text.

issues.verification: Five focused connection tests and the full 464-test native-UI suite pass. A rebuilt EXE was captured from its exact HWND and shows no overlap, overflow, duplicate label or input-field artifact.
